messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — my SDK PR (sdk#452) is blocked by api#879 + a small helm change. CI: unit + integ pass locally but CI e2e is hitting a flaky `TestKVCacheExpiry`. Who can review/approve the API and helm parts? Need plan for merge timing 

liam: I can review the SDK changes today. @aisha can you confirm runtime compatibility? Main question: does api#879 change wire format or add optional headers? If it’s opt-in we can stagger rollout.

aisha: api#879 only adds an optional header `x-rw-kv-shard` for sharded KV routing — runtime is backward compatible. Runtime needs a helm flag `kvShard.enabled=true` and a new configmap key `cache-shard-config` to be present when opting in. If SDK only sends header when feature-flagged, we’re fine.

henri: Console will need a small client bump (patch). Also helm chart needs that `cache-shard-config` key added to templates. I can cut the console PR once SDK publishes artifact. Suggest we coordinate a canary deploy.

maya: FYI CI flake details: e2e fails because test assumes 3 cache replicas; workaround is `helm test --set cache.replicas=1`. I added that as a CI override comment in the PR.

liam: Reviewing now, left one nit about retry backoff and one suggestion to add a tiny compatibility test harness script in the SDK repo (2-3 lines). Tagging @henri for console + `r?` on chart changes. :thumbsup: 

henri: I can approve console changes. Recommend canary at low traffic first — merge window today @ 11:30 PT? Route 5% traffic to canary for 1h and watch error rate/latency.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled for 2026-03-20T11:30:00-07:00. Runbook: `/scripts/canary.sh --service=runtime --image=redwood/runtime:v2.3.1-canary`

aisha: I’ll hold runtime rollout until SDK publishes stable artifact and the helm chart is updated in staging. Quick smoke I’ll run once canary is up: `curl -H 'x-rw-kv-shard: 1' http://runtime.test/health`

maya: Proposed plan: liam merges SDK after addressing the nit; I’ll merge API toggle PR once I see SDK release artifact in the registry; henri will deploy console bump and helm chart with `cache-shard-config` and `kvShard.enabled=true` for the canary. If e2e flakes again we’ll set the test to unstable and proceed with canary.

liam: pushed the fix, CI is green now (all checks successful). Requesting r+ from @maya.

maya: r+ — merging now. I’ll follow up with a canary status once deploy-bot reports.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: sdk#452 merged by maya at 1823456820

maya: Canary is live with 5% traffic, no errors in first 20m and latencies look stable. Will escalate to full rollout in 40m if metrics hold. Thanks all :tada:
